purpose: A standalone, machine-checkable decision that may authorize PF-1 only after every required external artifact and gate-evidence receipt has been resolved beneath an explicit artifact root, hash-verified, JSON-parsed, and bound to the same candidate release. It is intentionally not embedded in or inferred from a data-release manifest.
independence_invariants: candidate_release.release_status remains candidate; the decision artifact does not rewrite the release manifest

all candidate-release references and evidence receipts use canonical relative paths under an explicit artifact root; absolute paths, parent traversal, symbolic links, junctions, and root escapes are forbidden
every referenced file is SHA-256 verified and JSON parsed; declared schema_version, artifact_kind, subject_release_id, and evidence status must equal the referenced content
training_record_contract_sha256 equals the actual SHA-256 of p1_logical_motif_ce_first_contract_vnext1.json loaded by the validator
gate_results booleans and bare evidence hashes are not authorization evidence
an admit decision authorizes PF-1 only; PF-10 and PF-FULL require later promotion evidence
C3-specific gates and evidence are required only for c3_ema_state_prediction and forbidden for ce_first
